summary: Jets and reconnaissance planes lean into curved approaches and departures. The A-10 eases into its climb as it pulls out of the pass.
stage: Native Godot 4.7.2, trenches, seed 3, high preset, golden lighting, fixed 30 fps. Tracking camera at the same offset from the A-10, 93 fixed ticks after spawn.
rationale: At the same point in the flyover, the A-10 previously held its wings level. Now it banks into the curve.
source_ref: Main afe46c41 compared with the same revision plus this change.
